Kashmiri Pandits hold Janmashtami celebrations in Srinagar and Kupwara

Kashmiri Pandits marked the Hindu festival of Janmashtami with public celebrations in two locations in the Kashmir valley. In Srinagar, community members gathered for prayers and rituals that were described as being conducted with religious fervour. In the town of Kupwara, a large procession was organized, featuring participants marching through the streets. The Kupwara procession was reported as the first Janmashtami parade in the area in several decades. Both events took place during the Janmashtami festival period and were reported without mention of any disturbances. The celebrations highlight the visibility of the minority Pandit community in the region.
